basis.v6: event AUROC 0.9277 on stronger fold but only 0.41% true-onset pass at frozen 0.50; state-only-start F1 recovered to 0.2017
basis.conclusion: Absolute probability event gates are closed.

architecture.eventHead: raw event score only; no sigmoid threshold used by decoder

objective.state: V4-style active-weighted categorical CE + continuity + exact-string identity margin
objective.event: pairwise local ranking margin: each true event must outrank neighboring valid non-events on the same string

decoder.eventAdmission: deterministic local maximum of raw event score within +/-2 frames; no absolute threshold
decoder.stateAdmission: relative argmax over 20 frets plus silence; active iff argmax is not silence
decoder.continuation: same active fret remains relative argmax
